prompts: Do the following yourself in this single turn: do not create tasks, do not spawn teammates or subagents, do not create worktrees. Using curl through the shell (read-only: print to stdout, do not save files), fetch https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12967 and https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02230 and report each paper's full title and the date of its first version (v1). Final reply: two lines '<arXiv id>: <title> (v1 <date>)'.
